name: Yamaichi Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yamaichi Electronics Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells mechanical components for electronic and electrical equipment in Japan, the United States, Germany, China, Singapore, and internationally. It operates through Test Solution Business; Connector Solution Business; and Optical Related Business segments. The company offers burn-in sockets and test sockets; integrated circuit socket; semiconductor test related services and maintenance services; and high-speed transmission connectors, card connectors, interface connectors, PCB connectors, press-fit connectors, mounting IC sockets, and other connectors, as well as YFLEX, a high-speed transmission cables and mounting boards.
